description: This file defines the dmUtility class with static utility functions for string manipulation, query parsing, and multiset value parsing, used within a larger software project.

classes.name: dmUtility
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for string and query processing.

methods.name: splitQuery
methods.description: Splits a query string to extract the last component after a dot or backslash.

methods.name: has_suffix
methods.description: Checks if a string ends with a given suffix.

methods.name: isWildcard
methods.description: Determines if a string represents a wildcard (ends with a dot).

methods.name: trimWildcard
methods.description: Removes trailing dot from a string if present.

methods.name: trimProperty
methods.description: Removes the property part after the last dot in a string.

methods.name: trimPropertyName
methods.description: Extracts the property name after the last dot in a string.

methods.name: trimSetProperty
methods.description: Trims property or multiset notation from a string.

methods.name: parseMultisetValue
methods.description: Parses a multiset string into key-value pairs.

methods.name: splitString
methods.description: Splits a string into tokens based on a delimiter.
